context: Ren reports a quality issue to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (含ま/作ら/生じ/考えれ/箇所) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 製品に、不良の箇所が見つかりました。
lines.en: A defective spot was found in the product.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: どこで、不良が生じたのかね?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 作られる工程で、生じたようです。
lines.en: It seems to have arisen during the production process.
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 原因に、何が含まれているかね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 温度の管理が、含まれていました。
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: どう考えれば、防げるかね?
lines.en: How should we think to prevent it?
lines.style: engaged boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 工程ごとに考えれば、防げます。
lines.en: If we think process by process, we can prevent it.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: その箇所を、すぐ直してくれ。
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm closing throughout
